subject: [Books] Your inquiry about Built from Dust
body: Hi Dr. Chen, thanks for reaching out...

subject: [Books] Re: Built from Dust — Mars in your classroom?
body:
Dear Dr. Chen,

I hope this finds you well and that the end of the school year is wrapping up smoothly at Northfield Academy.

We connected back in April about bringing Built from Dust — Book I of the No Blue Sky series — into your 7th-grade science curriculum. You mentioned it caught your eye for its Mars colonization themes and the real engineering concepts woven through the story. I had a video call on the calendar for late April that I know fell through, and I wanted to circle back and see if the timing might be better now.

The book follows a team of colonists establishing the first settlement on Mars. It hits on actual science topics — ISRU (in-situ resource utilization), life support systems, radiation shielding, and the engineering challenges of operating in a partial-gravity environment — all wrapped in a narrative that keeps 7th-grade readers engaged. We've had several educators tell us it works well as a cross-curricular text for both science and English Language Arts.

If you're still interested, I'd love to:
- Send you a free educator review copy (digital or print — your preference)
- Share the curriculum alignment guide mapping the book's science content to NGSS standards
- Set up a 20-minute video call to walk through how other middle schools are using it

No pressure at all — I know summer planning is a busy time for curriculum directors. Even just a quick reply telling me whether the timing works or if I should check back in August would be incredibly helpful.

Warmly,
Bob Mills
MIFECO Publishing
